about_the_game:
SAVE THE REALM FROM DIVINE WARFARE

Journey across a dying realm consumed by divine conflict. As mortal champions resurrected by the Goddess of Light, you and your party must push back the encroaching darkness before the realm is overtaken by evil. Every step through the dying lands uncovers hidden relics, forgotten lore, and the realm’s fragile balance between hope and corruption.

STRATEGIC ROGUELIKE COMBAT

Engage in turn-based tactical battles where positioning, timing, and resource management decide survival. Every decision whether striking an enemy, casting a spell, or even defending builds Ultimate Charge, fueling powerful Ultimate Abilities unique to each hero. Shatter enemy lines, rally your allies, or unleash unstoppable force with these devastating Ultimates when the balance of battle hangs by a thread.

ENDLESS HERO BUILDS

Choose from 5 playable heroes, each with 3 distinct subclasses that reshape their powers and playstyle. With over 150 abilities, mechanic-shifting Blessings, and more than 200 unique items, every run offers a new path to mastery. Whether you reflect damage back at your foes, cripple them with layered debuffs, or dominate with raw ability power - each run forges new strategies as unique as the heroes themselves.

PLAY SOLO OR CO-OP

Lead your champions alone or rally up to three friends in fast-paced co-op play. With simultaneous turns for all players, battles remain fluid, tactical, and unrelenting as you fight for the realm’s survival together.

content_descriptors.notes: General fantasy medieval violence against heroes, NPCs, and enemies.

  • Graphics: Nvidia 1080

short_description: Step into a realm torn by divine conflict where every defeat is just another beginning in this roguelike, turn-based tactics adventure. Assemble your party, and defy fate in a world where every decision tips the balance between light and shadow.
